title: Telstra Prepaid TCL Tab 10L LTE Gen3 $39 (RRP $179 at Telstra) @ Woolworths
body:
Deal: Telstra Prepaid TCL Tab 10L LTE Gen3 $39 (RRP $179 at Telstra) @ Woolworths

[liamisred] Can't seem to find it on the website - will call around my locals
[DannyBoy] Yank ? Mum is the correct version you're after
[Frackingiscool] $39 is less than a decent cover for most phones/tablets, this is a great price for a base spec handheld to watch some iView on while camping.
[iSmart] what kind of ozbargainer spends $39 for a phone cover… $2 max on aliexpress, free delivery.
[Frackingiscool] Me sadly.
Dropped a phone, needed it, paranoid about dropping the new one, bought an OtterBox case before leaving the store.
It was my failure as a human that I forgot the OzBargain way.
[clubhonda] I've used $2 TPU covers on all my phones from Samsung notes to Ultras and tablets and dropped them plenty of time. Never even had a crack so $2 ones worked pretty well.
[Frackingiscool] @clubhonda: I dropped my pixel 8 with tpu cover and it dropped screen first onto an upright bolt thread on a worksite.
Nothing short of a wallet case could have saved it and I dislike them.
I needed the phone for clients so went from site to JB (5 minutes away) and bought a pixel 9 and an OtterBox defender from the phone kiosk at the same shopping centre. It was $85 and ugly as hell but protected the screen.
My personal phone is a cheap Motorola edge neo 50 with a $4 AliExpress TPU "airbag corner" (corner bubbles, looks dumb as hell) as the included snap on abs shell cracked within a month.
[carrawa] @clubhonda: Does that cover the screen too when not in use?
[Mjk698] $12 on Amazon delivered in a few days that's all I paid for a few of mine
[boozed] Probably a fair price for the hardware now
[Sleepycat3] I use these tablets as book ends for my shelving.
[jaboday423] What do people use this for with these specs?
[Frackingiscool] Kitchen tablet (recipes, doorbell, iView, jellyfin).
Kids (lock it down, educational apps/vids).
Camping (bird sound recognition, plant recognition, recipes, videos)
Garage tablet (pdf, newpipe tutorials, pornhub)
And at $40 you buy a few and not worry about dropping them/losing them/etc
[INFIDEL] Lots of uses for a cheap basic tablet.
Bought $29 7" tablet @Coles in 2014.
(1GB, Android 4, single core, wifi only)l
Its somewhere, probably still works.
Used it for years with apps, simple games, vids, assisting me in workshop & kitchen…
Finally ended up on old car dash, connected by app to Sony Bluetooth head unit.
Providing maps, music, & controlling stereo. It's best use
Until apps no longer were updated

[CodeXD] I called up my local store and quoted the number on the barcode in OP's photo
53746
They were able to find it from that. Otherwise, if they don't have stock, you can ask if any surrounding stores do.
[INFIDEL] Tips: Ask if they have actual stock, not just showing on their system. It may not exist.
Ask to hold it for you.
[UncommonName] Thanks for this tip. I reserved 2 at Dandy WW and just now returned home with these. None left there, if anyone is wondering.
PS: No returns accepted for these tablets.

Returns may be possible if not of merchandisable quality.
